description: Democratic Republic Congo (COD) - Hydropower Plants (2018) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). The Hydropower Plants are split into 3 categories: Existing, SNEL operated Existing, privately operated Planned. Coverage: the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It has 3 files in SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Hydropower. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
